works_the_facts.reason: The derived figures are correct and useful: one-eighth (9,000 of 72,000 lbs a year), about six weeks of fresh supply, and more than a quarter of the cost from reserves. right_comparison.reason: It states the alternative accurately (without cold pickup, offered produce gets turned away, as happened last summer), though it doesn't say what continuing without the van would mean for the year ahead.
